# GoSpell

> GoSpell is local voice dictation for Mac, Windows, and Linux. Hold a shortcut, speak, and GoSpell transcribes on the device and pastes the text wherever the cursor is.

- Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later): https://gospell.goml.io/files/releases/GOSPELL-latest-arm64.dmg, or `brew install --cask goml/tap/gospell`
- Windows 10 or 11 beta, x64 and ARM64: per-user Setup.exe installers at __ORIGIN__/
- Linux beta, x86_64 Arch with glibc 2.44 or later: `curl -fsSL https://gospell.goml.io/files/install-linux.sh | sh`

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/goml/gospell/blob/dev/README.md): features, settings, privacy, and troubleshooting
- [Windows guide](https://github.com/goml/gospell/blob/dev/docs/windows.md)
- [Linux guide](https://github.com/goml/gospell/blob/dev/docs/linux.md)
- [Transforms](https://gospell.goml.io/docs/transforms): the JavaScript API for changing dictated text before GoSpell pastes it, including `fetch` and `node:child_process`
- [Managing GoSpell](https://gospell.goml.io/docs/admin): macOS configuration-profile keys that turn off Meetings, Annotate, OpenCode processing, transforms, Labs, and updates, or hold transforms to this computer
- [GoSpell Labs](__ORIGIN__/labs): features GoSpell is trying out, each off until it's turned on in Settings › Labs or with `gospell labs on <id>`, one page per lab at __ORIGIN__/labs/<id>
- [TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/goml/gospell/blob/dev/sdk/typescript/README.md): local transcription for other apps
